output.text: {"notes":["The requested joint angles and angular velocities are in each joint’s local frame, with unwrapped right-hand angles in rad and rates in rad/s.","The tip position is requested in the right-handed world frame, where x is forward, y is left, and z is up; its unit is meters.","Both joints have constant applied torque −0.9545972419464508 N·m on [0,2.0), and joint_1 additionally receives +0.5 N·m on [0.4597,0.5597).","joint_limit_by_T is a boolean indicating whether either joint reaches an angle magnitude of 2.8 rad by T; contact onset is rearmed below 2.795 rad."]}
